scope: Functional McKernel OS/apps and Rust/assembly migration only; no security testing.
single_deadline: Actual stop timestamp (or normal-finally entry) +6seconds; creator TERM/KILL/direct wait and adopted-child retirement share actiondeadline+5; reserve1second for streamclose/fsync/durableFAIL receipts. No phase resets deadline. Unprovable joins and deadline overrun fail; no qualification of pathological uninterruptible filesystem fsync latency.
signals: Blocked through all retirement and durable closed receipt; creator stays WNOWAIT-unreaped until creator group signals finish; no group signal after reap. Adopted direct children retain existing waitpidWNOHANG+kill+reap ownership.
